source_timing_note: Published ES2002a closeup.smil and sides.smil start the RealMedia videos and Mix-Headset audio at 0s. This supports a common starting origin; fine A/V alignment still needs measurement on the exported clip.
known_audio_issue: AMI reports a badly worn headset for 'participant 1'. The meeting's info.xml labels P1 as the industrial designer, but verify microphone identity and signal before replacing a headset with a lapel; no channel is substituted automatically.
